                    <p style="text-align: center; "><em style=""><strong style=""><span style="font-size: large;"><font color="#da0d18">The most prestigious awards in the PR industry</font></span></strong></em></p><p style="text-align: center;"><span style="text-align: start;">PRWeek Awards</span><span style="text-align: start;">&nbsp;continue to set the undisputed benchmark for excellence by celebrating the UK’s most boundary-pushing individuals, teams, and agencies delivering world-class creativity and results.</span></p><p style="text-align: center; margin-right: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px;">Widely regarded as the best&nbsp;<span class="il" style="">awards</span>&nbsp;in&nbsp;<span class="il" style="">PR</span>, we pride ourselves on having a judging panel of 100+ industry experts from leading global brands and the best agencies in the UK.</p><p style="text-align: center; margin-right: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px;"><br></p><p style="text-align: center; margin-right: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px;"><span style="text-align: start;">We know it has been a challenging year defined by significant industry shifts and changing landscapes.</span><span style="text-align: start;">&nbsp;</span><span _ngcontent-ng-c2456668883="" data-start-index="581" class="ng-star-inserted" style="text-align: start;">Now more than ever, it is vital to recognise that power of a brilliant idea and the resilient people behind it</span><span _ngcontent-ng-c2456668883="" data-start-index="715" class="ng-star-inserted" style="text-align: start;">.</span></p><p style="text-align: center; margin-right: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px;"><span _ngcontent-ng-c2456668883="" data-start-index="715" class="ng-star-inserted" style="text-align: start;"><br></span></p><p style="text-align: center; margin-right: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px;">Whether your campaigns were led by a global network or a dedicated team of three, if your work showed boldness, sharp strategy, and undeniable results, you belong on this stage. Entering the PRWeek Awards is your opportunity to recognise that success and celebrate the exceptional work and dedication of your team over the past year.</p><p style="text-align: center; margin-right: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px;"><font color="#da0d18"><br></font></p><p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-weight: bolder;"><font color="#da0d18">Extended entry deadline: Thursday 21 May 2026</font></span></p><p style="text-align: center;"><span jscontroller="JHnpme" class="pjBG2e" data-cid="feaa9e08-1504-447b-94bf-f6c1e9a4456d" jsaction="rcuQ6b:npT2md" style="color: rgb(0, 29, 53); font-family: &quot;Google Sans&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; text-align: start;"><span class="UV3uM" style="text-wrap-mode: nowrap;"><span style="color: rgb(31, 31, 31); font-size: 20px; text-wrap-mode: wrap;"></span></span></span></p>

<section class="flow">

<article class="widget widget-paragraph widget-align-justify widget-size-100 ">
    <p dir="ltr" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"><strong><span style="font-size: 25px;">Diversity, Equity &amp; Inclusion Champions</span></strong></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"><strong><em style=""><span style="font-size: 25px;">In Partnership with</span></em></strong></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"><strong><span style="font-size: large;"> <img src="/media/2026/_Taylor%20Bennett%20Foundation%20resized%20%28400%20x%20200%20px%29.png"><br></span></strong></span></p><p style="text-align: center; ">The category will be judged by representatives from the Taylor Bennett Foundation, including members of its Alumni Advisory Board. This award is judged independently of your main category submission. You do not have to be shortlisted or win in your consultancy/team category to be successful here, entrants may win one, both, or neither.&nbsp;</p><p dir="ltr" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">This category rewards agencies, in-house teams or industry bodies that can demonstrate sustained, embedded action and tangible outcomes. Judges will assess evidence of expanded access to opportunities, improved retention and progression of individuals from diverse backgrounds, and leadership accountability.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Particular credit will be given to organisations that can demonstrate meaningful, measurable impact over time, rather than one-off initiatives or standalone campaigns.</span></p><p style="text-align: center; "><br></p><p style="text-align: center; ">PLEASE NOTE: You cannot submit a direct entry for this category. To be considered for this award, you must focus on the required DEI section within your consultancy or team entry. This specific section is what will be pulled and presented to our specialist judges. Entry is automatic based on your submission into one of the following categories:</p><p style="text-align: center; ">Boutique, Small, Mid-Sized, or Large Consultancy of the Year, In-House Team of the Year (Private or Public/Third Sector)</p><p style="text-align: center; "><img src="/media/2026/Koray%20Camgoz%20resized%20to%20300x300.png"></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><em>"Talent is everywhere in our industry, but opportunity is not. We’re proud to partner with PRWeek to recognise the organisations building inclusive workplaces where diverse talent can thrive and progress. Judged by Taylor Bennett Foundation Alumni, this award recognises organisations that treat inclusion as a core business priority - a long-term investment in stronger teams, broader thinking and sustained performance."</em></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><em><br></em></p><p style="text-align: center; "><span style="font-weight: bolder;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">-&nbsp;</span>Koray Camgöz, CEO, Taylor Bennett Foundation</span></p>
</article></section>

    </section>

                    <p><br></p><p><span style="text-align: justify;">"</span><span style="text-align: justify;">We're very proud to launch the 2026 PRWeek Awards, a the start of a fifth decade for PRWeek itself. Recognised as the most prestigious awards in the PR and communications industry, the PRWeek Awards showcase the industry’s best talent through a rigorous judging process. After a record-breaking 2025, we're confident this year will surpass it. We select top professionals and rising stars as judges, and once again, we’ll visit agencies and conduct live interviews for the Gold Award categories. Despite obvious challenges politically and culturally, the drive for excellence continues and it's looking another good year for the world-leading British comms sector. I look forward to reading your entries and making 2026 the most successful year yet!"</span></p><p><strong style="color: rgb(218, 13, 24); font-family: &quot;Segoe UI VSS (Regular)&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, Ubuntu, Arial, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;; text-align: var(--bs-body-text-align);">Danny Rogers,&nbsp;</strong><strong style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI VSS (Regular)&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, Ubuntu, Arial, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;; text-align: var(--bs-body-text-align); color: rgb(218, 13, 24);">Editor In Chief, PRWeek UK &amp; EMEA.</strong></p>
